additional_concerns: Executable meaning is unavailable because the supplied representation reports an unsupported '+' operator or arity. This does not establish any particular omission, conflict, restriction or permission in the implementation.

The classification threshold includes exactly 50% and aggregates direct and indirect exposure. Footnote 7 places the holistic discretionary assessment below 50%; designation factors alone do not establish an actual SFC designation.

A false result must not imply declassification, permission to distribute, or that an excluded LAF is non-complex. Missing exposure or designation evidence must remain distinguishable from established absence of a classification basis.

The source does not specify exposure valuation, look-through or double-counting methodology, designation expiry, or automatic declassification after exposure falls. These matters cannot be supplied by inference from the threshold.
The three supplied missing dependency IDs have no identifying authority metadata. No mapping to named external authorities can be established.
